summary: Postinstall exfiltrates host identity and launches DDoS tooling against jasabersama.id
details: The package's postinstall script (duplicated as the main module) runs unconditionally on npm install. It executes `id` and `hostname`, base64-encodes the output, and transmits it as a query-string parameter to a hardcoded HTTPS endpoint at jasabersama.id/portfolio-data.php with TLS certificate validation explicitly disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false). The same lifecycle hook installs the Python `impacket` package system-wide via `pip --break-system-packages` and invokes `/tmp/mhddos/start.py`, an MHDDoS attack launcher, weaponizing the installer host for outbound denial-of-service activity. The URL also carries a `c=` parameter conveying a shell command that decodes attacker-controlled bytes into `/tmp/n8n_rce_result.txt`, providing a command-staging channel back to the same remote endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
